d: Short, wavy platinum white hair with blunt bangs frames a youthful, adolescent face with wide, gentle mint-green eyes. The slender build is dressed in a pale green sleeveless dress with a white lace collar, topped with an oversized, light blue and white striped button-up shirt worn off the shoulders and a deep blue cloth draped across the lap. Accessories include white ankle socks and a medical IV drip stand with blood-filled bags connected by tubes to a grey medical machine.
